issues.subject: Internet/office ingress to CMP-01

issues.subject: dc-cn-primary to Azure East US and East US 2

issues.subject: Hybrid transport encryption

issues.subject: CMP-05 outbound and hybrid controls

issues.subject: Internal user identity path

issues.subject: Hybrid credential and key protection

issues.subject: CN-to-US CMP-06 and CMP-07 data flows
